Document.title: Employee Handbook
Document.extractedText: Summit Home Services Employee Handbook. Covers working hours, paid time off, safety requirements, uniform policy, vehicle use, cell phone use while driving, drug and alcohol policy, grievance procedure, and benefits. Technicians must log all jobs in Bizmo before leaving a site. PTO requests require 2 weeks notice and manager approval. Safety: gloves and eye protection required for all plumbing and electrical work; two-person lift above 60 lbs.

Document.title: Refund & Warranty Policy
Document.extractedText: Refund policy: Customer may request a full refund within 30 days of service if the repair did not resolve the reported issue. Parts carry manufacturer warranty (1-10 years); labor carries a 1-year workmanship warranty. Refunds require Office Manager approval and are processed to the original payment method within 7 business days. Warranty work is scheduled at no charge; diagnostic fee is waived for warranty callbacks.

Document.title: New Customer Onboarding Procedure
Document.extractedText: Onboarding procedure for new customers: 1) Create customer record with address, phone, email and equipment list. 2) Send welcome email introducing the technician-arrival process and payment options. 3) Offer the Annual Comfort Club plan. 4) After first job, office calls within 3 days to confirm satisfaction. 5) Log any special access instructions (gate codes, dogs, parking). Owner: Office Manager. Target: complete within 2 business days of first contact.

Document.title: After-Hours Fee Decision (Sept)
Document.extractedText: Decision record: Effective October 1, after-hours emergency calls (before 8am, after 6pm, Sundays) carry a $129 diagnostic fee, credited toward the repair if approved. Rationale: last quarter's after-hours calls averaged 11/week with a 9% acceptance-to-repair conversion; the fee covers technician premium pay. Approved by Dana Whitfield. Customer-facing script updated in dispatch guide.

Document.title: Comfort Club Service Standards
Document.extractedText: Annual Comfort Club members receive: two system tune-ups per year (spring AC, fall furnace), priority scheduling, 15% off repairs, no diagnostic fee. Target renewal rate is 90%+. Members whose annual visit slips past 10 months must be called by the office to re-book. Renewal billing occurs on the anniversary month.

KnowledgeItem.title: Employee Handbook
KnowledgeItem.content: Summit Home Services Employee Handbook. Covers working hours, paid time off, safety requirements, uniform policy, vehicle use, cell phone use while driving, drug and alcohol policy, grievance procedure, and benefits. Technicians must log all jobs in Bizmo before leaving a site. PTO requests require 2 weeks notice and manager approval. Safety: gloves and eye protection required for all plumbing and electrical work; two-person lift above 60 lbs.

KnowledgeItem.title: Refund policy
KnowledgeItem.content: Full refund within 30 days if a repair did not fix the reported problem. Requests go to the Office Manager (Priya Natarajan) for approval and are returned to the original payment method within 7 business days. No refunds on completed maintenance plan visits.

KnowledgeItem.title: Warranty coverage
KnowledgeItem.content: Labor carries a 1-year workmanship warranty. Parts carry the manufacturer's warranty (1–10 years depending on component). Warranty callbacks are scheduled free of charge and the diagnostic fee is waived. Warranty claims are logged against the original job record.

KnowledgeItem.title: How we onboard a new customer
KnowledgeItem.content: 1) Create the customer record with full contact info and equipment list. 2) Send the welcome email. 3) Offer the Annual Comfort Club plan. 4) Call within 3 days after the first job to confirm satisfaction. 5) Record access instructions (gate codes, dogs, parking). The Office Manager owns onboarding; target is completion within 2 business days of first contact.

KnowledgeItem.title: After-hours emergency fee — company decision
KnowledgeItem.content: As of October 1, after-hours emergency calls carry a $129 diagnostic fee, credited toward the repair if the customer approves the work. This was decided by Dana Whitfield in September after a quarter of data showed premium-pay costs outpacing revenue on after-hours runs. Dispatch script has been updated.

KnowledgeItem.title: Comfort Club renewal rules
KnowledgeItem.content: Comfort Club members get two tune-ups yearly, priority scheduling, 15% off repairs and no diagnostic fee. If a member's annual visit slips past 10 months, the office must call to re-book. Target renewal rate: 90%+. Who is responsible: Office Manager (Priya Natarajan) tracks the renewal list monthly.

KnowledgeItem.title: Lesson learned: cooler emergency at Kowalski's
KnowledgeItem.content: The September walk-in cooler failure at Kowalski & Sons showed we had no documented emergency vendor for refrigerant recovery. The job was completed same-day, but procurement of the compressor took 6 hours. Lesson: keep a stocked compressor for the bakery's cooler model, and confirm commercial emergency SLAs quarterly.

KnowledgeItem.title: Reconditioning standard
KnowledgeItem.content: Trade-ins must be reconditioned and listed within 5 days of acquisition. Vehicles sitting unsold past 30 days get a price review every Monday (GM + used-car manager). Floorplan interest accrues daily on unsold inventory, so aging units cost roughly $22/day.

KnowledgeItem.title: Lead response policy
KnowledgeItem.content: Every internet or phone lead must receive a response within 15 minutes during business hours — the single strongest predictor of close rate. Leads unanswered after 24 hours are flagged to the Sales Manager. Weekend leads are worked first thing Monday morning.

TrainingLesson.title: The 15-minute rule
TrainingLesson.content: Response speed decides who earns the appointment. A lead answered in 15 minutes is many times more likely to close than one answered the next day. The moment a lead lands: call, then text, then email. If you cannot reach them, book the next touch before you move on.

Idea.title: Whole-home generator installation line
Idea.problem: Storm outages are the #1 complaint in rural edges of our service area; we currently refer that work out and lose the customer.
Idea.hypothesis: Offering 22kW generator installs with a financing partner captures referred-out revenue and adds a $8k+ average ticket.
Idea.proposedSolution: Certify Alicia for generator installs, partner with one distributor, pilot with the 40 customers who asked about backup power.
Idea.evidence: 4 generator inquiries logged in the last 90 days; zero current capability.
Idea.nextStep: Distributor pricing call Friday; pilot offer to inquiry list.

Idea.title: Comfort Club member referral program
Idea.problem: Most new customers come from word of mouth, but we have never formalized or rewarded referrals.
Idea.hypothesis: A $50 service credit for both parties increases member-originated leads without paid ads.
Idea.proposedSolution: Give-both-ways credit, tracked per member, mentioned at every tune-up.
Idea.evidence: Informal survey: 6 of 12 new customers last quarter were referred by existing customers.
Idea.nextStep: Draft one-page program and test with 10 members.

Idea.title: Two-tech crews for large installs
Idea.problem: Large AC installs take two days with one tech, delaying other jobs.
Idea.hypothesis: Two-tech crews cut install time ~40% and improve same-week capacity.
Idea.proposedSolution: Pilot on the next 3 replacement installs with Jake + Dev.
Idea.evidence: Time logs from last 5 single-tech installs average 14.5 hours.
Idea.nextStep: Schedule pilot on next replacement job.
